notes:
Background: Brightline provides a hybrid SaaS ticketing layer used by retail + logistics customers. Current pain: manual tagging and long mean handle time (MHT). They've tried heuristic rules + regex tags but maintenance is costly.

Key objectives / success metrics:
- Auto-tag precision >= 90% (goal 95%) on top 20 tags (product, billing, shipping, returns)
- Summaries: 1–2 sentence agent-ready TL;DR, reduce followup clarifications by 30%
- Throughput: support volume 350 reqs/min typical, spikes to 1,200 reqs/min during promos; need predictable cost under spikes
- Latency: agent-assist (summary + tags) must return < 500ms ideally for UI flow; fallback allowed to 800ms
- Rollout: start with triage queue + internal agents (beta), then enable macros and Zendesk ticket automation rules

Integration details called out:
- Zendesk test org available (sandbox) with sample macros and triggers; Freshdesk not primary but may be added later
- Want tag taxonomy to map to custom ticket fields (cf_tag, cf_priority) and to triggers (macros) for automated routing
- Need webhook for human-in-the-loop corrections (agents can override tag; corrections feed into training loop)

Technical asks / Redwood fit:
- Interest in hosted_api for POC due to speed, but want Dedicated options for production to guarantee latency/SLA during promo spikes.
- Must support VPC peering and customer-managed KMS for ticket content encryption at rest.
- Requesting automatic fallback to smaller quantized model when Dedicated pool saturated (policy-based routing).
- Want prefix/KV caching for repeated ticket threads to reduce token costs on long exchanges.

Security & compliance:
- Data residency: EU for EU customers; primary data plane in us-west but need option for eu-west region for EU accounts.
- Retention: want ability to purge PII after N days per customer; integration with retention_controls required.

POC plan (agreed):
- Week 0: Sandbox provisioned (Redwood hosted API creds + Zendesk app install).
- Week 1: Ingest 2k historical tickets -> run batch tag/summarize -> measure precision/recall per tag.
- Week 2: Live triage beta: agent UI panel, streaming summary + auto-tag, agent feedback loop.
- Deliverable: precision/recall report, latency/cost breakdown, recommended Dedicated config + burst sizing.

Quotes / rep notes:
- Priya Nair (Head of Support): "If auto-tags are wrong more than 8% of the time agents will stop trusting them — we need high precision before wide rollout."
- Engineering: concerned about token costs for long ticket histories; asked about caching & partial-history summarization.

Open questions for Redwood:
- Provide example routing policy template for spike handling (preferred fallbacks, cost thresholds).
- Confirm SSO (SAML) test flow and KMS key rotation window.
- Share sample performance profile for a 16-GPU Dedicated pool and expected tokens/sec for our avg ticket length (~650 tokens).

Attachments/refs: pricing deck (drive link), security FAQ (drive link), fireflies call IDs above, RFC for tag taxonomy (attached in drive).
